text: Rotary parlour, stalls 1 to 12 during the 4am milking: pull the ear-tag numbers off the stall snapshots with top-grade reading accuracy and bump it to the front of the queue, and the frames must not leave the dairy's own network. I first said archiving them was fine, but the herd manager overruled me, so wipe each image as soon as its tag is read. The vet's cow-count request lives on its own ticket.

quick ask: could you tally the IV bags hanging in the bay 4 monitor snapshots over tonight's round, just the number, not the boxed-up version cardiology wanted? the vendor's hosted servers can crunch it, everyday accuracy does the job and it's not a rush. i'd said crank it to full performance earlier but scratch that, run it in battery-saver mode.

The Provider shall transcribe the stamped VIN characters captured by the welding-arm camera on Line 3 throughout the overnight production run, and such jobs shall not wait behind any other queued work. The imagery was originally to be processed only inside the plant; under the schedule amendment agreed with Plant Engineering, it may instead be handled at the Provider's regional data centre. Inference hardware shall run in its full-power, minimum-lag configuration. Part counting, as requested separately by the paint shop, falls outside this clause.

GridWatch notice: the hotspot scan on transformer bay T2 is queued for tonight's peak window. Return one figure, how many bushings are running hot, at top-tier accuracy, moved ahead of other jobs and run flat-out with no throttling. This was set to purge frames after analysis, but the maintenance lead now wants them on hand for next year's asset audit; the switchyard crew's boxed-location request belongs to a different work order.

Okay assistant, count the insulators showing hot spots in this morning's east feeder walkdown images and just give me the number, I can't afford a single miscount on this. There's no hurry, and keep it on the power-saving setting. Oh, earlier I said wipe the images afterwards, but actually go ahead and hang on to them; the boxed overlay Priya wanted is her team's thing, not mine.

Hi Marco, for the northbound toll gantry at exit 14 during weekday commuter hours, we need each vehicle in the frames found and framed with a box, and the regional cloud cluster can do the processing. I'd asked for premium-grade detection last week, but after checking the budget, plain baseline accuracy will do. This isn't time-critical, so a regular place in the queue works; please run the nodes at full throttle with minimal lag, and we'll want to pull these frames again for the annual audit, while the plate-reading job the enforcement team raised stays with them. Thanks, Dana

Lane 3 X-ray at the southern crossing, covering the overnight freight queue: locate each item in the scanned crates and draw boxes around them, baseline accuracy is enough, the scans never leave the checkpoint's own servers, archiving them is fine, and keep the scanner node in power-saving mode. Logged this as no-rush, but the duty supervisor has since bumped it to the front of the line. The item tally the canine unit wants is theirs, not this job.

yo, can you get me a count of the parcels in the Elm St kiosk's overflow bay this afternoon, just a number, and no need for fancy precision? said no rush earlier, but the courier's showing up in 20 minutes and I need it before then, so bin the photos once you've got it. the box-drawing thing is the returns team's job, not ours.

Under this schedule, the Contractor shall extract licence-plate characters from frames captured at the Kingsway and Fifth intersection throughout evening peak hours, at the premium recognition grade. Whereas the prior draft allowed that imagery to be processed at the Contractor's cloud facility, the revised terms agreed by council counsel require that it not leave the roadside cabinet. Edge units shall operate in their full-power, lowest-latency profile. Vehicle counting, which is covered under the separate congestion-study contract, is excluded from this clause.

CheckPoint Hub: request updated for the bay 2 undercarriage scanner, weekend inbound traffic. It originally asked for a tally of flagged items; it now needs each one located and outlined with a box, and premium accuracy isn't needed. The unit is running off backup cells, so treat every watt as precious, and ignore the full-throttle profile the K9 team used last month.

Hey Atlas, go through today's inspection photos from the segment 12 pressure-sensor station and box every corrosion patch, ordinary accuracy is plenty, stay in eco mode, and nothing leaves the compressor station's local rack. I told you to scrap the photos afterwards, but my supervisor wants them stored, so go ahead and keep them. The gauge-reading job is Ahmed's, not mine.

Hi Jonas, re the haul trucks on the north pit ramp during day loading: I originally asked for every truck in the dashcam frames to be boxed and located, but what we actually need is the fleet numbers painted on the tipper bodies read off as text. The head-office servers in Perth can do the crunching. A single wrong digit can't be tolerated, so please make the reading as accurate as it gets; the tyre tally the maintenance crew keeps asking about falls under a different request. Thanks, Leila

Pump station 4 wet well, overnight inflow period: I first asked for the pump nameplates to be read, but after talking to Ray we just need the rag clumps on the bar screen counted, number only, and being off by one or two is fine. The images may be archived; run the node flat out with no power-saving. The boxed-outline output the SCADA team set up last month isn't wanted here.

any chance the shelf robot could read the price tags in aisle 7 during tonight's restock, crunching it on the cloud side is ok, it has to be dead-on accurate, and run it at full power? i flagged it as a rush earlier but the promo got pushed back, so it's not a rush anymore; ignore Sam's gap-counting thing too, that's the inventory team's.

The Vendor shall read the licence plates of vehicles passing the extended stop arm, as captured in camera stills from all district buses during morning pickup runs, and may process such stills at its hosted facilities. Although the initial scope accepted baseline recognition accuracy, the district's transport committee has since required the premium recognition grade. Each request shall be handled ahead of routine queue items, and no still shall be kept once its text has been extracted. Student-counting services, which the attendance office procures separately, are outside this agreement.

ShelfSense: job update for the dairy cooler aisle during Saturday opening hours. Read the expiry dates printed on the yoghurt lids; this was cleared for cloud processing, but loss prevention now says the images mustn't leave the store's back-office server. Flagged as priority, archiving the scans is allowed, and the facings count requested by merchandising is not part of this job.

Hey Nova, for bays 5 through 9 at the charging hub overnight, find every car and trailing cable in the feed and draw boxes around them, sharpest detection you've got. The hub's running off the solar battery tonight, so sip power. I said you could save the clips, but on second thought don't hold on to anything once it's processed, and the full-power mode the fleet team asked for isn't for this.

Hi Tomás, regarding the platform screen doors on the southbound side at Central during the evening peak: my first note asked for passengers near the doors to be boxed and located, but operations only needs a figure for how many people are standing in the door zone. You're welcome to run this on the transit authority's cloud tenancy, and please don't keep any frames once the figure is produced. The signage-reading request from the wayfinding team is separate and shouldn't be bundled in. Thanks, Mei

Pedestrian hall baggage X-ray, morning ferry arrivals: box and locate each liquid container in the scan images, ordinary detection accuracy is enough. Raised this as a rush first, but the inspector says tomorrow's review is soon enough, so it can wait its turn. Nothing gets saved after processing; the item tally the biosecurity desk asked for is their request, not this one.

mate, could you count how many cows went through the rotary during the evening milking off the stall cam stills, only the figure, and run the box at full power? the co-op's cloud can handle the maths but don't keep the pics after. i said it was a rush before but Dad says Friday's fine now, and the lameness boxes the vet wanted are a different job.

The Operator shall report the number of foreign-object items found on Runway 09/27 during overnight closure inspections, as a single figure per sweep. No imagery shall be transferred beyond the airfield's own equipment room. Although the original schedule classed these reports as expedited, the amended schedule places them in the routine queue, as next-morning delivery is acceptable. Localised box outputs, as requested by the airside safety team, are not required under this clause.

MedAir: Theatre 3 air-quality panel photos from this morning's pre-op checks need their display readouts transcribed, with no tolerance for misread digits, and pushed ahead of the backlog. Processing on the vendor's cloud is allowed, and the images should be available for the quarterly accreditation audit. Mode changed from full performance to battery-saving at biomed's request; the particle-count analysis infection control ordered is separate.

Hey Sentry, for the north gate turnstiles during tonight's match entry, spot every person and bag in the footage and box them. I'd said regular accuracy would do, but security now wants the sharpest detection possible, and they'll want to replay the footage next week. Don't run the power-hungry mode, stay on eco, and the headcount the ticketing team wanted is their business, leave it out.

Hi Priya, for the helmet scanner at the east entry of the Riverside tower site during the 6 to 7 am sign-in window, we need the worker ID numbers on the helmet stickers read out as text, and our cloud provider can handle the processing. I first asked for the top recognition tier, but the stickers are large and clear, so regular accuracy is fine. This can't wait, please put it ahead of other work since the inspector arrives Monday; the headcount the site office requested belongs to their own ticket. Thanks, Sam

Haul road between the crusher and the waste dump, night loading cycle: locate and box every light vehicle that comes near the trucks in the collision-cam frames, and the frames don't have to stay on the truck, the head-office compute cluster is fine. Logged as baseline accuracy originally, but after last week's near miss safety wants the most precise detection available. The vehicle tally dispatch runs is their own thing; leave it off.

hey, can the compactor bin on Pier St read the permit numbers printed on the commercial waste bags during the weekend market, really precise please, and the pics stay on the bin's own board, not the council cloud? i said we could keep the images but legal said nope, so delete each one right after it's read. oh and ignore the bag-counting job, that's the recycling team's.

The Service Provider shall return, for each inspection image taken in the engine room during the vessel's watchkeeping rounds, the total number of visible oil drips beneath the main engine as a single integer. The original draft of this clause called for premium-grade analysis; following the charterer's review, premium-grade analysis is no longer necessary and baseline accuracy is adequate. Inspection images shall form part of the vessel's maintenance history. Bounding-box localisation, which the classification society has requested under a separate survey, is not required hereunder.

CleanTrack: for the Grade A filling line during the current batch fill, count the particles on the filter-membrane images and return just the total. Accuracy was set to routine, but QA has raised it to the most exacting level; process ahead of the queue, the images must not leave the facility's validated network, and delete each one once counted. The colony-outline mapping requested by microbiology is not part of this job.

Hey Rigby, on truck 42's dashcam for this afternoon's ramp climb, I first said read the plates on the light vehicles, but actually just find each vehicle and draw a box around it, and no sloppy boxes, I want the most precise detection you've got. Go ahead and send the clips up to the Perth data centre for that. The vehicle tally the control room wants is theirs, not mine.

Hi Aroha, for the drone survey over the eastern paddocks during this week's lambing, please have the model mark each ewe and lamb in the imagery with a bounding box. The footage shouldn't leave the farm's own base station, and there's no hurry, end of the week is fine. I originally asked for the full-power flight profile, but given battery life we've decided the battery-sparing mode is better, and the headcount report the stock agent asked for is his request, so ignore it. Cheers, Hemi

Cleanroom 2 filling suite, weekend media fill: switch this from boxing each particle to returning just the particle total per image, since QA only needs the figure. Precision must be top-tier, the corporate cloud can run the analysis, and keep the reader economical rather than at full power. The OCR of batch labels that packaging asked for sits with them, not here.

hey, for the toll gantry on the M4 westbound over the long weekend, can you get the model to box every motorbike in the frames? i said basic accuracy would do, but bikes keep getting missed, so we need the best detection it can manage. not in a hurry though, next week is fine; the plate-reading stuff is Lena's job, leave that.

The Service Partner shall transcribe the leg-band numbers visible on birds in the tropical aviary imagery captured during daylight feeding sessions. Whereas the initial schedule accepted baseline recognition accuracy, the curatorial team now requires the most exacting recognition grade. Imagery may be processed at the Service Partner's hosted facilities and may be retained for the studbook record, and such requests carry no expedited status. Animal counts, which the keepers commission separately, are excluded.

VineWatch: for the Block 7 station camera this harvest week, the task has changed from reading the rain-gauge label to locating each bird on the netting and boxing it. No need for premium accuracy, bump it ahead of other jobs, and the images should stay on file for this season's crop-loss claim. The starling count the neighbouring grower asked for isn't ours.

Okay Herdbot, for the teat-cup camera on the rotary during morning milking, I said give me a count of the cows, but change that: find each teat and put a box on it. Make it as accurate as possible, the co-op's cloud servers can do the work, and use full power, no eco mode. The ear-tag reading the vet asked for isn't part of this.

Hi Kenji, for the jet fans in the southbound bore of the Harbour tunnel during the overnight maintenance closure, we need the serial numbers on the fan nameplates read from the inspection photos. The operator's cloud can do the processing, and please don't keep the photos once the text is pulled. I'd said there was no hurry, but the contractor arrives tomorrow morning so we need it bumped ahead; run it in power-saver mode as usual, and the fan tally the mechanical team wanted is a separate job. Thanks, Wen

Inverter row C at the west array, midday peak: count the lit fault LEDs across the panel-cam shots and return one number, maximum precision, head of the queue, no power-saving, and file the shots for the warranty claim. Initially wanted this processed only on the farm's local box; ops has since cleared sending it to the regional cloud. Boxed fault locations are the O&M contractor's request, not this one.

right, we need the model to box every blockage in the inlet screen photos from the Riverside pump station during tonight's peak inflow, sharp as possible, no half-guesses. it's fine to process them on the council cloud, and we'll want the photos for the insurance claim. i said there was no rush earlier but the pumps are tripping now, so we need it right away; the level-gauge reading is Tariq's job, not this.

The Supplier shall supply, for each log imaged at the debarker infeed during each production day, the tag number printed on the tag stapled to its end. The original schedule set recognition accuracy at the baseline tier; by amendment of the mill manager, the Supplier shall instead deliver its most exacting recognition grade, with misreads not tolerated. Counting of logs, which the yard team handles under its own arrangement, forms no part of this clause.

ShipLink: for the bilge camera on the Singapore to Rotterdam passage, return only how many oil-sheen patches appear per frame; shore-side fleet cloud processing is permitted, no rush on delivery, and images may be kept. Power mode changed from eco to full performance per the chief engineer, and the boxed overlay the superintendent's office requested belongs to them.

Hey Volta, at the charging hub on Beach Road over the evening peak, find every car blocking a charger and box it, and get it done right away. I said keep it all on the hub's local box, but the manager's fine with the cloud, so send it up. Store the footage, run it flat out without throttling, and the queue-length count is the parking team's, not ours.

Hi Grace, for the air-quality sensor cabinets in the northbound tunnel between portals 2 and 3, I first asked for each cabinet to be located and boxed in the survey photos, but what we actually need is the calibration due date on each sticker turned into typed entries for our register. The dates can't be even slightly off, so please use the most accurate recognition you have. The cabinet count the asset team requested last month is theirs and doesn't belong here. Thanks, Ben

Harvester 7 on the Blackwood coupe, day felling: count the logs stacked at the landing in the boom-camera frames, just the figure, top-tier accuracy since it feeds the royalty return. First logged as no-hurry; the contractor now needs it before the truck leaves at noon, so move it up. The frames go in the coupe audit file, don't drain the battery pack, and ignore the species-label reading the mill asked for.

yo, how many fans came through the south turnstiles before kickoff tonight? one number is all I need, and it's fine to run it on the stadium's cloud, max power, and don't keep the frames after. said it wasn't a rush earlier but the fire marshal wants it now, so bump it up; the face-box thing security set up last season isn't for this.

The Vendor shall locate, and mark with bounding rectangles, each infusion line and lead visible in bedside monitor camera frames from Ward 5B during overnight observation periods, and may perform such processing at its hosted data centre. The initial schedule permitted baseline analytic accuracy; at the direction of the clinical safety officer, the Vendor shall now apply its most exacting detection grade. Frames shall not be retained after processing, and compute resources shall operate in their power-conserving profile. Reading of chart text, as commissioned by the records department, is excluded.

SiteGate: for the west hoist helmet scanner during morning inductions, read the licence numbers on each worker's helmet sticker. Cloud processing was approved earlier, but the builder has since ruled that no scan may leave the site office server, and each one is purged once read. Payroll's worker tally is a separate request.

Hey Harbour, count how many passengers cross the gangway at berth 2 for the 7:40 sailing, a number is all I need, and regular accuracy's fine. I'd said send it to the cloud, but the terminal manager wants it kept inside the terminal building now. No rush, save the clips, keep it in eco mode, and the bag-boxing thing belongs to the security team.

Hi Olivia, for the smart poles along Harbour Promenade between 10 pm and 2 am, we'd like the pole cameras to report only how many pedestrians pass each pole. No footage may go beyond the pole's own edge unit, and there's no hurry on results, weekly batches are fine. I originally asked for the full-performance setting, but council now prefers the low-power mode, and frames should be erased straight after counting; the plate-reading request from the parking team isn't relevant to this. Kind regards, Theo

Eastbound toll gantry at the Airport Link merge, evening peak: locate every vehicle straddling lanes and box it, top-grade detection please, and the frames don't leave the gantry cabinet. Originally logged as routine, but the operator has since escalated it and needs it done ahead of everything else. The plate-text reading the billing team requested is their job, not this one.

morning! could we get the car numbers read off the trains at the Central platform screen doors over the morning peak, cloud processing is ok, ordinary accuracy will do, run it full power and don't keep the frames? i said it was a rush earlier but that's changed, whenever it's done works now; passenger counts are the ops team's thing, skip those.

The Monitoring Contractor shall read the aircraft registration markings visible in imagery from the Mount Kaputar watchtower during daylight fire-season patrols; this replaces the earlier schedule, which called for a numeric tally of aircraft. Imagery shall not be transmitted beyond the tower's own equipment hut. Baseline recognition accuracy is acceptable, and these requests are to be handled in ordinary queue order. Hotspot localisation, which the fire-behaviour team contracts separately, is excluded.

FlareWatch: for the north flare stack camera during tonight's blowdown, report only how many of the six flare tips are lit. Initially flagged as a priority job, now downgraded by the control room: no rush, next-day delivery works. Run the edge unit in full-performance mode; the plume boxing the environmental team set up last month doesn't apply here.

Hey Bridget, read the numbers off the strain-gauge logger displays in today's photos from the east tower cable anchorage, send them up to the cloud for that if you like, and don't keep the photos afterwards. I told you to rush it before, but the engineer says Monday's fine, so take your time; the crack-boxing request is from the inspection firm, not me.

Hi Farid, for the penguin enclosure camera during feeding sessions this week, my first request was to box and locate each bird, but the keepers actually need the numbers on the flipper bands read off. Our cloud account can run the processing, it doesn't need premium accuracy, and this has to jump the queue because the vet audit is Thursday. The overall bird count the education team wanted is a separate thing. Cheers, Anna

South flare boom, during the scheduled night blowdown: give a count of the flare tips burning, number only, everyday accuracy will do. Was going to run the unit in max-performance mode, but the platform's on generator rationing, so go gentle on the unit instead. Don't retain any frames after counting; the smoke-plume boxing the enviro team asked for stays with them.

hey, can the infeed camera read the grade stamps on the logs coming through the saw line this arvo? images stay on the mill's own server, nothing goes out, and no rush on it. i said run it at full power but the boss wants power-saving mode, and the log count is the yard crew's thing.

The Operator shall return, as a single number, the count of debris items found on taxiway Charlie during each night inspection sweep, and such results shall be handled ahead of all other queued work. Whereas the prior schedule required imagery to be deleted after analysis, the aerodrome safety manager has directed that it remain available for later incident investigation. Processing hardware shall not run at full output; its power-conserving mode applies. Bounding-box localisation, requested by the wildlife team for bird strikes, is excluded.

FleetSafe: stop-arm cameras on the Northside route buses, afternoon drop-off runs. Request changed from boxing vehicles that pass the stop arm to reading their licence plates, with top recognition accuracy. Plate images must not leave the bus's onboard unit; the passing-car tally the district office wants is handled separately.

Hey Bin Buddy, for the compactors along the Queen Street mall this weekend, I asked you to box the overflowing bags, but scratch that, read the account codes printed on the bin lids instead. Let the council's cloud do the heavy lifting, max power, and don't store any of the images once they're read. The fill-count report is for the waste contractor, not us.

Hi Raj, for the interior cameras on the Route 12 buses during afternoon runs, we need each child's seatbelt picked out and enclosed in a rectangle in the frames. My earlier note said baseline accuracy was fine, but after the parent complaint the principal wants the most precise detection available. Please prioritise this above other jobs, and no frame should outlive its processing; the seat-number reading transport services mentioned is not something we need. Thanks, Claire

Theatres 1 to 4, weekend deep clean: transcribe the reading shown on each air-sensor display from the photos, baseline accuracy is fine, the photos never leave the hospital network, archiving is allowed, and keep the reader in low-power mode. Opened as a rush, but infection control says Monday is fine, so it can wait its turn. The particle tally the engineering team raised is on their ticket.

hey, for the drone run over the east paddock trial plots this week, i asked for a count of the marker stakes, but can you read the plot codes written on them instead? nothing fancy accuracy-wise, no rush, feel free to keep the images, and fly it in battery-saver mode. the weed-boxing thing is the agronomist's request, not mine.

The Inspection Provider shall extract the serial numbers and calibration dates printed on the strain gauge housings along the main girder, as photographed during quarterly inspection walks; this supersedes the earlier schedule, which called for the housings to be localised with bounding boxes. Such requests shall not be expedited and may take their place in the routine queue. Photographs shall be erased upon completion of extraction, and processing equipment shall run in its power-saving profile. Gauge counting, commissioned separately by the asset management team, is not covered here.

GridEye: for the 132 kV yard thermal camera during this afternoon's load test, locate each overheating clamp and box it; premium accuracy isn't needed, the utility's cloud may process it, and the images belong in the asset history. Mode switched from eco to full performance by the protection engineer; the clamp count the asset team wanted is not included.

Hey Sawyer, on the green chain camera during the afternoon run, find every knot and split on the boards and put a box around each one. I said regular accuracy would do, but the grader wants the best detection you can manage now. Don't crank it to full power, we're on the peak-demand tariff, and the board count is the dispatch crew's job, not this.

Hi Jess, for the parcel lockers in the Eastgate mall food court over the Christmas period, could the kiosk camera report just how many parcels are left uncollected at close each night? There's no rush on these, a daily summary is fine, and please delete the images as soon as each count is done. I'd set the kiosk to its eco setting earlier, but the vendor says counts lag badly, so please switch to full performance; the label-reading job the courier firm asked about should stay out of it. Thanks, Omar

Robot stall 3, morning milking: read the yield figures on each stall's milk meter from the stall cam stills. Baseline accuracy was fine at first, but after two cows' yields got swapped in the records the herd manager wants the most precise reading we can get; the tanker arrives at 9 so it goes first, run it at full power, and don't keep the stills once read. The body-condition boxing the nutritionist asked for isn't this job.

any chance you could count the erosion chips in this morning's blade shots from turbine row 3, just a number, and asap because the crane's booked for tomorrow? i said bin the photos afterwards but the insurer wants them now, so don't delete them. fly it in eco mode too, the full-power profile is the survey team's thing.

The Supplier shall read the bag-tag numbers from images captured at reclaim carousels 4 to 6 during international arrival banks, and may process such images at its off-airport data centre. Whereas the initial schedule accepted baseline recognition, the airline consortium now requires the most exacting recognition grade available. Requests under this clause are not time-critical; images shall be purged immediately after reading, and processing hardware shall run at full output with minimal lag. Bag counting, as requested by ground handling, is excluded.

TrackScan: for the Western line sleeper survey between Penrith and Emu Plains overnight, read the date codes stamped on each concrete sleeper. Scans must not leave the inspection car's onboard server. Keeping scans was allowed initially, but the rail authority has since required each scan to be wiped right after reading; the crack-boxing output the maintenance crew uses isn't wanted.

Hey Hardhat, on the level 12 slab pour today, find every worker without a helmet in the scanner feed and draw a box around them, as accurate as you can possibly get it. I said keep the footage on the site server, but the builder's cool with using the cloud now. Don't hang onto any of it afterwards, and the sticker-reading thing is for payroll, not this.

Hi Nikolai, for the strain gauge loggers under the western approach span during the overnight load test, we need the values on each logger's LCD read off the photos, and none of them may leave the bridge's monitoring server. I'd said we could retain them, but the asset owner has since asked that each photo be deleted as soon as its values are read, and please run the reader at full power with the lowest lag. The crack-mapping boxes the consultant asked for are a different engagement. Regards, Hana

Theatre 6 HVAC panel, during the weekly air-change check: first asked for the sensor units to be found and boxed, now changed to reading the pressure values shown on the panel display. Not time-critical, and the handheld reader is on its last battery pack, so go easy on it. The unit count biomed engineering raised is their request.

hey, quick one: can you count the bird-strike marks on the nacelle shots from the drone pass over turbine 14 this arvo, just the number? it's a priority since the engineer flies out at five, full power, no eco stuff. i said we'd hang onto the photos but the landowner objected, so wipe them once counted; the damage-boxing is the OEM's job.

The Provider shall report, as a single integer per pen, the number of fish visible at the surface in sensor-buoy imagery from the salmon pens at the Huon lease during morning feeding. The draft schedule allowed imagery to be stored; following the farm's privacy review, no image shall outlive the production of its count. Processing shall run at full capacity with no power-saving measures applied. Individual fish localisation, requested by the veterinary contractor, is excluded from this schedule.

BorderScan: pallet X-ray at the freight annex, overnight inbound. The job has moved from reading container codes to reporting a bare count of undeclared packages per pallet; typical accuracy is enough and it isn't time-sensitive. Scans stay inside the checkpoint's secured server, run at full power, and the item-boxing the quarantine team asked for is excluded.

Hey Marina, count the sea lice on the fish in pen 6's sensor-cam shots from this morning, just the total, and I need it dead accurate and right away. I said keep processing on the barge, but head office cleared the cloud, so send it there. Don't store the shots after, stay on battery-saver, and the fish-boxing thing is the vet's.

Hi Leon, for the giraffe house camera during the night-time observation window, we'd like the text on the enrichment feeder labels read so keepers can log which feeder each animal used. I first said baseline accuracy would be fine, but the research team needs the most accurate reading possible. No hurry at all, the images can go into the study archive, and please run in low-power mode; the animal count the visitor-experience team asked for is a separate request. Best, Ruth

Summit chair gate, Saturday opening hours: count the skiers passing the ticket gate, a single figure per hour, with the tightest accuracy available since it feeds the lift-capacity report. Filed as a rush, but the mountain manager says Monday is fine, no need to hurry. The pass-number reading the ticketing office uses is their job, not wanted here.

need the yeast cells counted in the microscope shots from fermenter 5's sample, a single figure is all I need. it can't wait, we decide on the pitch at 2. i said run it at full whack earlier, but we're on the solar budget today so eco mode instead, and the label-reading job is the packaging crew's.

The Integrator shall supply, for each asset shown in thermal imagery of the Northgate substation switchyard during quarterly thermographic surveys, the identifier printed on its nameplate; this replaces the prior requirement to localise hot components with bounding boxes. Imagery shall not be retained once the identifier has been extracted. Processing equipment shall operate in its full-power, minimum-lag configuration. Hotspot counts, as requested by the network planning team, are beyond the scope of this clause.

VineSense: for the bird-netting camera at the Block 3 station over the veraison period, box every bird perched on the nets. No rush, the weekend is fine. The station was set to full-performance mode, but the grower switched it to a frugal power setting to protect the solar battery; the bird count the neighbouring estate requested is not ours.

Hey Metro, read the plates on the cars running the red at King and George during tonight's late run, nothing leaves the intersection cabinet, and regular accuracy's fine. I said there was no hurry, but police need it before midnight, so put it first. The vehicle count for the traffic study isn't mine, skip that.

Hi Fiona, for the rotary parlour's hoof camera during afternoon milking, we'd like each cow's hooves located and boxed in the frames so the lameness team can review them. I'd said the footage had to stay on the farm's own PC, but after speaking with the co-op, it's fine to process it on their cloud servers. We don't need premium accuracy, you can store the frames for the herd records, and please keep the system in its eco mode; the ear-tag reading the milk buyer requested is a separate job. Thanks, Callum

Westbound bore fan gallery, during the Sunday night closure: count how many jet fans are showing a fault light in the inspection photos, just the number.
